title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative compressible NS state/closure and residual paths are documented and implemented.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS zones, mixed cells, boundary tags, face geometry and adjacency are represented in mesh modules.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-based residual assembly and global norms are present.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov flux and viscous corrected-central paths are present; accuracy is limited by dissipation.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic treatments are documented and source-backed.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Weighted least-squares primitive reconstruction is called before interior-face fluxes.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-Jespersen limiter and reconstructed-state positivity fallback are active source paths.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Gradient, Newtonian/Fourier, wall treatment and force split code are present.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Block-Jacobi/LU-SGS pseudo-time paths and CFL controls are source-backed.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 outer loop/frozen histories exist, but Re200 exits at five iterations when residual merely decreases, not at the stated 1e-3 target.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS graph partitioning, owned/ghost state, Isend/Irecv and reductions are present; no evaluator rank rerun.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
